task: Choose min(K, number remaining) distinct molecules before any outcome is revealed. Update only when all measurements in the batch arrive.
objective: Minimize number of batches to first optimum. Report compounds purchased too, charging the whole successful batch. Top2/3/4 are secondary targets; initial qualifying hit costs zero.
scope: Deep Sets and pair Set Transformer values with beam/swaps, batch-aware PPO, Gumbel topK, and covariance-aware GP batches. Random, individual EI topK and previous single-item NAP topK are reference baselines.
backbone: Previous auxiliary neural-mean/conventional-kernel GP, seed11 and previous auxiliary weight. Frozen; no GP retraining. Same existing grouped folds and predictor/RL role split.
data: Six endpoints, five grouped outer folds; only RL-role training pools supply selector training labels. Endpoints retain previous transformed/directed objectives and starting-hit normalization.
qualification: Requested K=4,7,10 are withheld during training. Truncated batches can have realized sizes4 and7; size10 is beyond the training maximum8. Metrics are reported for the tested sizes.
features: Frozen GP mean, SD, incumbent, neural-delta summaries, log EI, training-PCA coordinates relative to hit and hit coordinates; observed-count and outcome summaries. Pair features are GP posterior correlation, log1p mean-squared PCA distance and absolute predicted-mean difference.
set_scorer: Predict probability a complete subset contains any global optimum (binary cross entropy), plus0.1 Huber regression of best actual relative utility. Three random/mean-biased/EI-biased subsets per training context. Deep Sets pooling or pair-bias and pair-message self-attention followed by invariant pooling.
PPO: Autoregressive K choices with pending-set pooling and relation summaries. GP updates follow completed batches. Supervised initialization then PPO reward minus1 per completed batch; all choices in a batch share its remaining-round return. Validation selects the checkpoint, including initialization.
Gumbel: Variable-K iterative relaxed slots with common Gumbel perturbations; optimize soft probability of including an optimum plus0.1 optimum cross entropy. Validate hard deterministic topK.
search: Validation-select greedy, beam4, beam4 plus one swap sweep, or completion-rollout search. Pair-aware set scores use corresponding rows and columns. Score equal-cardinality candidates. Width64 search checked against exhaustive small instances.
GP_batch: Joint qEI uses128 correlated Sobol Gaussian draws, beam4 and one swap sweep. K=1 uses analytic EI. Mean-fantasy EI updates covariance with posterior-mean pseudo observations, keeping the real incumbent fixed.
training: Four configurations per family,160 supervised/relaxed screen steps (+40 PPO updates),two finalists600steps (+160PPO),best validation configuration repeated at seeds29,47. Six rollouts per PPO update.
validation: Mean top1 rounds normalized by exact random expectation, equal mixture all pools and ≥15 pools if at least3 linked groups. Screening12validation pools; refinement32; one start. K2/5 for screening,2/3/5/8 for refinement. Validation subset chosen by fixed label-independent RNG.
evaluation: Four matched initial hits from worse half of each pool. All≥3 pools and primary≥15; exact analytic random expectation includes ties and incomplete final batches. Three learned-selector seeds, GP seed fixed.
inference: Paired linked-group bootstrap after averaging starts and seeds. Primary comparisons against joint qEI at K2,5,8 for four learned families; Holm adjustment over12 tests. Exploratory development-fold evaluation.
attachment: Molecular outcomes are observed individually. The GP supplies the joint batch objective under an individual-outcome model.
